Our story

Our journey together

How we met

Our paths crossed through friends, and from the very first conversation the laughter never stopped. What began as an easy friendship slowly became something neither of us could imagine life without.

The proposal

On a day that felt like any other, David asked the question with a nervous smile and a ring in hand. Jenifer said yes before he could even finish.

Why this day matters

We are celebrating with the people who have prayed for us, laughed with us and cheered us on. Thank you for being part of our story as we begin our next chapter together.
